warnings.message: 74.95% is not supported by its cited sources, metric type, unit, and precision.
warnings.excerpt: Both 2025-07 and 2025-08 exceed the five-percentage-point threshold for an anomaly, which calls for  focused historical review  ( anomaly rule ). Two cautions: the same-category mean also fell in those months ( 74.95%  and  76.82% ), pointing to a category-wide pattern rather than an airport-specific one; and monthly weather totals for those months ( 144.6 mm  with 3 adverse-weather days in 2025-07;  111.6 mm  with 4 days in 2025-08) are aggregates that cannot be tied to specific flights or days ( 2025-07 weather ,  2025-08 weather ). Note also that the 2025-11 weather row is flagged missing-data, so its populated cells should not be used ( 2025-11 weather ).
